title: docs(spec): the view filter any-of group is described as live, not planned

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GryRwZRPx8VGbUQRn2eZiM)_
Fixes #28522

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:视图筛选「任一满足」组 `{ or: [...] }` 的 spec 说明文字与 `$or` 拒收提示,去掉「[PLANNED] 尚无控制台读取 / 载入即被拒」的旧说法,改述现状;同步 liveness 注记与生成的参考文档。无行为改动。
- 为什么改:控制台那一半已落地(#28370,PR #28475),`/meta/types` 与拒收提示仍告诉作者这个形态不可用,把人引向两个视图或客户端变通。
- 风险与回滚:仅文字;schema 接受与拒收的内容逐字节不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。描述文字随 `dist` 与 `src/**/*.zod.ts` 发布,故带 patch changeset。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`(`ViewFilterOrGroupSchema` 文档注释与 `.describe`)、`packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts`(`$or` 拒收句)、`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`(`list.filter` 注记)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/view-filter-or-group.test.ts src/ui/filter-rule-array-guidance.test.ts`,预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The console now applies a view filter's any-of group: `toFilterNode` in `ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts` lowers `{ or: [rule, ...] }` to one `or` node inside the list's AND, and the filter builder edits a filter that is exactly one group (`builderRulesOfSpecFilter`, the save fold in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts`). The spec still said the opposite. This PR corrects the prose only.

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema`: the `## [PLANNED — not yet rendered]` docblock section becomes `## Applied by the console`, which names the lowering and the builder's one-group rule. The `.describe` loses its `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` prefix and the "No console reads it yet … refused when it loads" sentences; it now ends "The console applies it, ANDed with its sibling elements, and its filter builder edits a filter that is exactly one group."
- `packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts`: the `$or` refusal still prescribes the any-of group element, without "(declared, but no console applies it yet, so it does not narrow the rows today)". The code comment no longer cites the PLANNED note.
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, `props.list.children.filter.note`: the "rides this live verdict at PLANNED strength" sentence is amended as it asked, citing the group read (`toFilterNode` via `viewFilterOrGroupToNode`, reached from `ListView.tsx` `buildEffectiveFilter` through `mergeFilterNodes` and from `ObjectView.tsx`; the builder fold and its read-back). Status stays `live`.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, `dollarKeysReason`: the TODO reason that the record-form filter conversion gives for a `$or` record drops "(declared, not yet applied by any console)".
- `content/docs/references/ui/{view,page,component}.mdx`: regenerated by `gen:docs`. Each changed line is only this describe.
- `.changeset/28522-view-or-group-live.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## Why

Every author, human or AI, who reads `/meta/types` for a view `filter`, or who writes a MongoDB-style `$or` and gets the parse refusal, was told the group is not applied and that a view storing one fails to load. That steered them away from the one shape that works.

## Tests

No behaviour changed, so there is no new behaviour test and no ablation. Two pins held the old wording and are updated:

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view-filter-or-group.test.ts`: the describe pin now asserts the description starts with "An any-of group:" and carries no `[PLANNED` marker (it asserted the marker before).
- `packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array-guidance.test.ts`: the `toContain('no console applies it yet')` line is removed; the pin that the refusal names the any-of group element stays.

## Acceptance notes

- The liveness note edit is outside the claim's listed file surface but inside the card's Wanted ("Any liveness / marker register row that lists this key as planned moves with it"). No other register lists the key as planned. A line grep missed one more copy of the false status: `dollarKeysReason` in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` splits it across two string literals. The contract review found it (record 6585135393), and it is fixed here. A re-sweep with literals and comment lines joined finds no other copy.
- `.changeset/28020-view-filter-or-group.md` and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` keep their wording; both are release-owned history.
- Main was merged before opening (16 commits, including PR #29447 at other `view.zod.ts` hunks). `view.mdx` was regenerated from the merged tree; the branch's delta vs `origin/main` is exactly the nine files above.
